## Geographic change

Describe the change and source/evidence. Do not include private personal data.

- [ ] One JSON per feature at its permanent path
- [ ] Existing ID/type/provenance retained; revision and previous hash updated
- [ ] Deletions retain tombstones
- [ ] Geometry and source/license verified; no proprietary map copying
- [ ] Checked for duplicates in the existing map

Admins: inspect JSON diff, source license/evidence and before/after GeoJSON in the
`community-record-review` artifact. Check bounds, duplicates and public-data
appropriateness. Approve the current commit. Validation does not verify facts.
